_readme: Eval cases for the sweep's two Capture detectors beside drift (agents/uno-bot/src/sweep/capture-detector.ts): undocumented answers (C3) and decisions in running notes and Roadmap cards (C4). Each case is one thread or record and the pages it reaches, the detector reply recorded for it, and what the parse must keep. tests/sweep-capture-detector.test.ts replays every case through the real detector over the fake ModelProvider and fails when what is kept differs from `expect`. The shapes to tell apart: an answer given only in chat versus one a page already states; the section an answer belongs under, or a new section when none fits; and a decision in a note versus discussion. Plain text, under docs/evals/, so uno-bot's read guard withholds it from the bot being measured (docs/evals/fixtures/README.md).
